figurative_meaning_en: As per the order; the work will be done according to the command
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ্ঞে, আমি এখনই কাজ শুরু করছি।
example_sentences_in_english: Yes sir, I will start the work right away.
As per your order, it shall be done.
note: Equivalent to Hindi 'Jo hukum', used in polite or hierarchical interactions in Bengali culture
